items.html: And Rachel, who is called the mistress of the house, the true Nukva of ZA, has no coupling then. As we shall explain her matter and her place now at night, for she descended to Beria, and there she cries and asks of the blessed God concerning the destruction of the Holy Temple, and as it is written: 'A voice is heard in Ramah, etc., Rachel weeping for her children, etc.' And she also gives songs and thanksgivings to Him all night, in the secret of 'O God, be not silent to You,' as mentioned in the Zohar, portion Lech Lecha. And the matter is that Rachel is called Elohim, and is called El, and she is not quiet and silent all night, but always praises Him, may He be blessed.
